name: demo-wall
description: Local greeting wall. Notes and snippets stream into a poster. Approval publishes it onto a category board.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @demo-wall/observability && npm run build -w @demo-wall/agent-core && npm run build -w @demo-wall/agent && npm run build -w @demo-wall/wall
scripts.test: npm run test -w @demo-wall/observability && npm run test -w @demo-wall/agent-core && npm run test -w @demo-wall/agent && npm run test -w @demo-wall/wall
scripts.check: node scripts/no-any.mjs && npm run build && npm test
